title: Twin Babies in Double Pram Carriage, Yard - Antique 1910s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate early 20th-century outdoor snapshot capturing two babies (likely twins) seated facing forward in a deep fabric-sided double baby carriage or pram. One infant holds a teething ring or toy, looking directly toward the camera, while the other looks slightly to the side. The scene is set in a sunny backyard next to a wooden walkway or ramp. The reverse shows black paper remnants from an old photo album and a faint purple stamped number '21'.
